description: This file defines a React functional component 'SuperNoteImporter' that provides a user interface for converting notes into a custom 'Super' note format. It manages state, handles conversions, and renders a modal with a block editor and plugins.

classes.name: SuperNoteImporter
classes.description: A React functional component enabling note conversion to a special 'Super' format, including UI controls and state management.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates the component state with new note text and preview.

methods.name: performConvert
methods.description: Performs the note conversion by initializing the NoteViewController and saving the note.

methods.name: confirmConvert
methods.description: Handles the confirmation process for converting a note, including closing the dialog and calling conversion functions.

methods.name: convertAsIs
methods.description: Converts the note to 'Super' format without changes, after user confirmation.
